stations.title: Ivo
stations.say: Can I get this week's workshops?

stations.title: The studio
stations.text: Workshops on a paper sheet by the door.

captions: At Kilnworth Pottery, Ivo needs this week's workshops for his sign-up page.
The workshops are only on paper, and nothing answers his request.
You create the Express app, its routes and a JSON 404, in three tasks.
Now the page asks for the workshops and gets every one of them as JSON.
Same request, a real answer. And a clear no for anything else.
